headline: Approved Stack Storage changes at 679 Main Street, Library Commons updates, and plan to sell city parcels.
summary: The board adopted the Comprehensive Plan update and agreed to clarify that orientation limits apply only to signs over 80 square feet. It also asked the City Councilor for more information on two marijuana facility applications. Hearings on a parking reduction at 61-69 Suffolk Street and a fence height permit at 230-232 Beech Street were continued to October 13, 2026.
decisions: Continued the parking reduction special permit hearing for 61-69 Suffolk Street because the applicant was not present.
Continued the fence height permit hearing for 230-232 Beech Street because the applicant was not present and a board member was attending a site visit.
Continued the Comprehensive Plan revisions zone change hearing after an update from Lauren Niles.
Approved plan to combine parcels 3 and 4 for sale to the Log Cabin and sell parcels 1 and 2 (54 acres) for conservation, 4-0.
Approved three notices of decision for Library Commons Phase 2 project updates, 4-0.
Approved amendments to the Stack Storage project at 679 Main Street, 4-0.
Approved sending a letter to City Councilor asking for more information on the 'Diablo Man' LLC marijuana application at 73 Sargeant Street, 4-0.
Approved sending a letter to City Councilor asking for more information on the Red Barn Growers' LLC marijuana application at 1 Cabot Street, 4-0.
Approved minutes of earlier meetings, except 3/28/23, 11/12/24, 5/14/24, and 8/25/26, which were continued to October 13, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the parking reduction special permit hearing for 61-69 Suffolk Street to October 13, 2026, 5-0.
Continued the fence height permit hearing for 230-232 Beech Street to October 13, 2026, 5-0.
Agreed to clarify that the BG sign orientation restrictions apply only to signs over 80 square feet.
Adopted the Comprehensive Plan update after reviewing revised materials from staff.
Continued the Comprehensive Plan revisions hearing to October 27, 2026, 5-0.
